title: Kabaaru ilam mawɗam
intro: Oo neɗɗo dariima no feewi e muñal e nder teeminanɗe, ina noddira renndo ngoɗngo feewde e annoore goonga tawa ina jokkondiri e jaleeɗe e jaɓde. Ko waawi heen wonde fof, e teddungal nulal ngal ina yaaji e yontaaji, oo maccuɗo ina jokki e darnde mum en haa yamiroore sakkitiinde yalti.
clues: Mi waɗii duuɓi teemedde jeenay e capanɗe joyi miɗo nodda leñol am e laawol pooccingol jamma e ñalawma e nder sirlu e nder gite.
Mi jeertinii leñol am jukkungo mettungo, kono ɓe mbaɗi koppi maɓɓe e noppi maɓɓe, ɓe cukki koye maɓɓe e comci maɓɓe ngam mawnikinaare.
Mi yamiraama mahde huunde mawnde e les gite Joomiraacfo am, hay so ndiyam alaa e gite am.
Miɗo golla, ardiiɓe leñol am ina njalta ina njaltina mi, kono mbiy-mi ɓe ɓooyataa ko enen ngonata ƴattooje ɓe.
Miɗo ñaagii ɓanndu am e ƴiiƴam am nde njokkondirta e am, kono ɓe cuɓii ko ɗaɓɓude reentaade e dow tulde, ɓe ngoongɗini ko ɗum hisnata ɓe e ɓuuɓol ngol.
Laana am haa jooni arii e dow tulde Judi caggal nde leydi ndii ɓuuɓtii ndiyam mum, asamaan oo dartii toɓooli mum.
arabic: وَقِيلَ يَـٰٓأَرْضُ ٱبْلَعِى مَآءَكِ وَيَـٰسَمَآءُ أَقْلِعِى وَغِيضَ ٱلْمَآءُ وَقُضِىَ ٱلْأَمْرُ وَٱسْتَوَتْ عَلَى ٱلْجُودِىِّ ۖ وَقِيلَ بُعْدًۭا لِّلْقَوْمِ ٱلظَّـٰلِمِينَ
verse: And it was said, "O earth, swallow your water, and O sky, withhold [your rain]." And the water subsided, and the matter was accomplished, and it [i.e., the ship] came to rest on the [mountain of] Jūdiyy. And it was said, "Away with the wrongdoing people." (11:44)
